data.narrative:
Alef Aeronautics is a Series A-stage Transportation company that has raised $30M+ to date. The broader transportation sector contains eight private comparables, including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Pipedream, and FleetZero, though no public peers exist for direct benchmarking. The narrow peer set—same-stage, adjacent-stage players with similar valuation tiers—lacks sufficient density (minimum three datapoints required) to reliably apply median multiples.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach. Using the $30M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-later-stage transitions yields an implied valuation of $60M. This method assumes capital raised approximates post-money valuation at entry and that standard multiplication factors reflect investor expectations for frontier transportation ventures at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $51M to $69M, centered on a $60M median. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrowly comparable peers in transportation at Series A stage, which limits the ability to validate stage-progression assumptions against actual market precedent. The implied range reflects plausible bounds around the stage-based calculation rather than triangulation across multiple independent methods. Material clarification on post-money valuation at the most recent financing round would strengthen confidence in this estimate.
